items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Paul Baron led the band, and Mildred Bailey was the singer. Oh, I'm leaving out Red Norvo.

ctx.x: Downtown, we had the boogie-woogie pianists Pete Johnson and Albert Ammons and Joe Turner and a comedian, various ones, and then we went uptown we had Mildred Bailey, Savo --
